code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated erythrocytes, increased RDW, high ferritin, CRP, LDH, and INR, with low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages and elevated basophils. These findings suggest significant inflammation, possible infection or systemic inflammatory response, and coagulopathy. The combination of hypoxemia and these hematologic/biochemical abnormalities warrants urgent clinical evaluation for severe infection (e.g., sepsis), hematologic disorder, or other acute systemic illness.
Provider Organization: Spitalul de Psihiatrie Palazu Mare
